violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §744.1203(10))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: When switching groups a caregiver did not inform the other caregiver how many children were in the group

finding_variants.text: When switching groups a caregiver did not inform the other caregiver how many children were in the group

This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver brought a child to a room to use the restroom and when the caregiver left the room, they did not inform the other caregivers in the room that the child was in the restroom.

This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.  Caregivers failed to communicate to one another by verifying which caregiver had assumed responsibility of a child while the child was permitted to enter and exit the building between group activities.
It was determined that a caregiver did not appropriately communicate with other staff that a child was going to stay inside with another group, resulting in children being unsupervised.
